parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Lord Jesus Christ, who said, greater love than this no man has that a man lay down his life for his friends, through the intercession of Saint Maximilian Kolbe whose life illustrated such love, we beseech you to grant us our petitions:

For the Grace to Love Our Lady and Fellow Man as Generously as Saint Kolbe Did: Through the Militia Immaculata movement, which Maximilian founded, he spread a fervent devotion to Our Lady throughout the world. He gave up his life for a total stranger and loved his persecutors, giving us an example of unselfish love for all men, a love that was inspired by true devotion to Mary. Grant, O Lord Jesus, that we too may give ourselves entirely without reserve to the love and service of our Heavenly Queen in order to better love and serve our fellowman in imitation of your humble servant, Maximilian. Amen.
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

blocks.title: Days 1-9

fragments.text:
Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name.
Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses,
as we forgive those who trespass against us.
And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
fragments.title: Our Father

fragments.text:
Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
fragments.title: Hail Mary

fragments.text:
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
